Absorption |80||160||240||480||1280 |} == Related skills == * {{Skill icon|Phase Shield}} * {{Skill icon|Urn of Saint Viktor (skill)}} == Notes == * Activated by dropping the [[Urn of Saint Viktor]] or by using the skill [[Celestial Summoning]]. * The amount of damage absorbed is divided equally among all [[ally|allies]] within its radius ''except for [[hero]]es'', [[minion]]s, and [[spirit]]s. The amounts will be rounded up. For example, ** A level 1 urn will shield the player and [[Danika]] from 40 damage each (total of 80). ** If [[Jamei]] is also in the affected area, each character will be shielded by 27 damage (instead of 26 or 26/27/27).
